quote: Reporting officials submitting performance evaluations will enter "000" in Section A, Item 8.d. (height) and 8.e. (weight).

fix: MARADMIN 209/26 cites MCO 1610.6B in its narrative. Treat as a typo for 1610.7B.

fix: Exceptions: 31 days for active duty lieutenants and FD reports, and meaningful personal contact under 5c. N/O reports carry only pages 1 and 5.

fix: CD is a significant duty change under the same RS. PCS or leaving the billet is TR.

claim: Adverse: marks A through C in any of the six attributes, a MUE comparative assessment in Section G, or adverse content in Section H or I.
quote: Sections D through H. Any mark of "A" is adverse.
fix: Only an A mark in sections D through H is adverse. B and C are not. Comparative assessment is section K item 3 and is not an adverse trigger. Also adverse: section A markings and section I comments.

claim: Adverse reports submit within 60 days after the end of the reporting period.

claim: MRO statement is submitted within the time limit specified in the order (typically a defined window).
quote: The MRO has five working days after referral of the report to return the completed statement to the RS.
fix: State five working days and the extension request in writing.

claim: Time limit is a defined window after FITREP receipt in Chapter 7. Late petitions are typically rejected.
quote: Normally, appeals will not be considered if more than three years have passed since the document was entered on the record
fix: Three years from discovery. A late petition needs an explanation of why justice requires review. Rewrite lines 139 to 150.

claim: PERB outcomes are affirm, remand, partially correct or remove, and the PERB decision is final within the PES framework.
quote: Should the PERB disapprove, in whole or in part the Marine
fix: PERB grants (MMRP-13 changes the record) or disapproves. A disapproval forwards the petition to BCNR for final determination with a Marine Corps position statement. The PERB cannot render an evaluation less favorable (4c(4)).

claim: Substantive corrections go to the PERB at MMPB-21.

claim: PERB members are senior officers selected by the CMC.
